dataset.license: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL) v1.0
dataset.citation: Jeffrey Pennington, Richard Socher, Christopher D. Manning. GloVe: Global Vectors for Word Representation. EMNLP 2014.
dataset.normalization: none; source values cast to f32 and exported with 9 significant digits
dataset.split_policy: prefixes of upstream train/test splits; updates are disjoint train rows after the base subset; not the full ANN-Benchmarks dataset

limitations: Bounded subset, not full ANN-Benchmarks or modern sentence embeddings. Shared unpinned host; whole-child RSS, not marginal-index RAM. Mixed query times include synchronous rebuilds. No general recall/latency guarantee.

measurement.process_peak_rss_scope: whole benchmark child including dataset, database, exact oracle, index and queries; not marginal index memory
